# uzc_vpcs (Data Source)

Lists UzCloud VPCs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "uzc_vpcs" "all" {}

output "vpc_slugs" {
  value = [for v in data.uzc_vpcs.all.vpcs : v.slug]
}
```
